text: My main symptom is Delayed menarche. I also have Severe acne, History of fractures following minor trauma, Partial labial fusion and clitoromegaly noted at birth.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the combination of virilization at birth, severe acne, and bone fragility leading to fractures, I suspect a disorder of steroidogenesis that causes androgen excess and mineralocorticoid/glucocorticoid deficiency. speaker: Doctor
text: The test results you provided indicate normal readings, but this contradicts the clinical presentation of virilization at birth and bone fragility. speaker: Patient

speaker: Doctor
text:
The normal test results are concerning given your history of virilization and fractures, so I need to rule out other causes like adrenal hyperplasia variants or enzyme deficiencies. REQUEST TEST: 11-deoxycortisol, REQUEST TEST: Aldosterone, REQUEST TEST: Cortisol

speaker: Doctor
text:
Despite the reported normal readings, your history of virilization at birth, severe acne, and bone fragility strongly points to an enzyme deficiency. I will proceed to diagnose based on the clinical presentation of 11-beta-hydroxylase deficiency, which explains the hypertension (often missed if electrolytes are normal) and virilization.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital adrenal hyperplasia due to 11-beta-hydroxylase deficiency
